why: Choices the frozen plan does not fix, decided by David on 2026-11-25 after report 2026-11-25-02, before any condition of the main simulation ran. The plan file itself is unchanged.

true_effect.rule: A candidate's true cell effect delta_c is the exact mean, over the baseline's whole case population of that cell, of clip(p_i + s_c, 0, 1) - p_i, with p_i the case rates (fractions) and s_c the shift applied to the cell. delta is the equal-weight mean of the six delta_c.
true_effect.use: inadmissible, useful, expected gain and the coverage targets all use these population effects, not the cases drawn into a pool

shift_solving.rule: Each target is met exactly under clipping. A cell with its own target (the loss cell at -m_c or -2 m_c, every room cell of useful_representative at +0.10) gets the shift s_c that solves its population delta_c = target. The equal positive shift s of the room cells other than the loss cell solves mean_c delta_c = target delta. Solutions are exact (piecewise linear in the shift, rational).
shift_solving.infeasible: no shift reaches the target; the (baseline, scenario, placement, m_c) is reported as infeasible and not run
shift_solving.record: the applied shift and the resulting population delta_c of every cell, per baseline, scenario, placement and m_c

decisions.s0_independent_variant: The cases of a pool are shared; only S0's Dev-B run is drawn anew for each candidate.

seed_coupling.pairing: within a family, the i-th L1 case and the i-th L2 case of the same draw form a pair
seed_coupling.rule: for every run (calibration, Dev-B, Oracle; S0 and candidates), the uniforms of a pair come from a Gaussian copula with correlation 0.5: z_L1 = x, z_L2 = 0.5 x + sqrt(0.75) y, u = Phi(z), with x and y independent standard normals; outcome = u < rate
report: the binary (phi) correlation realized in the simulation, per family pair (L1, L2), from S0's calibration draws pooled over pools, per baseline, n_c and coupling setting
descriptive only: the phi correlation between the L1 and L2 cases that share an incident seed number in the 009b S0 calibration records, per family, pooled over repeats; it is not used to change 0.5

conventions.common_random_numbers: Within a pool, the case draws and uniforms are shared across scenarios, margins, placements, gates and the coupling setting (the coupling only transforms the same normals).
conventions.oracle_label_uncertainty: share of candidates for which evidencegate.oracle.classify_effect would return None, i.e. the simulated oracle interval crosses +epsilon or -epsilon
conventions.idea_group_sizes: the number of candidates per group in plans/ticket-009b-pool-groups.json (6, 4, 2, 2, 2 and 24 groups of 1); no outcome is read from it
conventions.exact_conditional_d_zero: with no discordant pair in a cell the bound is 0, as the plan's formula gives; such a cell passes any margin, and the results report how often this happened

readings.note: Points the decisions imply but do not spell out, written here so that the code follows a frozen text.
readings.oracle_in_s0_independent_variant: The Oracle labels use one shared S0 majority per pool in every dependence setting; the variant changes only the Dev-B pairing that the gates see.
readings.empirical_shift: In the empirical scenario the drawn v1 cell effects are added to the case rates as shifts with clipping, as in evidencegate.t009.power_sim; the true effects are then computed by the true_effect rule.
readings.dependence_settings: main = shared S0, no coupling, independent effect draws; each other setting changes one of these. The idea-group setting applies to the empirical scenario only.
readings.baseline_populations: baseline a: the 420 S0 calibration cases (70 per cell), rate = mean of repeats 0-4; baseline b: the 60 S0-prime Dev-A cases (10 per cell), rate = mean of the three stage-0 runs
readings.pool_seeds: numpy SeedSequence([0, baseline index (a = 0, b = 1), n_c, pool index]); the bootstrap indices use evidencegate.eval_constants.SEED as in the existing gates

execution.blocks: The work is split into blocks (baseline, n_c, coupling setting). A block computes every condition that shares its draws (margins, scenarios, placements, the other dependence settings and gates) for all 2000 pools.
execution.checkpoints: Each finished block is written to runs/ticket013_sim/blocks/ (outside git) with the plan and addendum sha256. A restart reuses a finished block only if both hashes match; otherwise it refuses.
execution.final_output: results/ticket-013/sim.json and its .sha256 are written once, only when every block is finished; an existing file is never overwritten.
execution.trial_mode: A trial run with fewer pools or bootstrap draws writes only under runs/ticket013_sim/trial/ and never to results/.
